+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'AgentEnvironment takes the skills tool: one source for the skills: preload and the skills tool'
+---
+## What
+
+Now the host gives the skills two times. It gives `AgentEnvironment(skills: SkillsRegistry)`, which the `skills:` preload reads. It also gives `tools.register("skills") { skillsTool }` in the `ToolCatalog`, which the runs call. These two can be different registries, with different marketplaces, paths and visibility rules. Then an agent can preload a skill that its `skills` tool does not show, or the opposite. The user decided (2026-10-09): an agent takes a reference to the skills tool, so that the preload and the tool always use the same skills. The agents must not guess.
+
+## Design
+
+- `AgentEnvironment` takes the skills tool (`SkillsCatalogTool`) in place of `skills: SkillsRegistry`. Remove the `skills` registry parameter. This is a breaking change (feat!).
+- The environment registers that tool in its `ToolCatalog` under the name `skills`. The host does not call `tools.register("skills")`. If the host also registers a `skills` entry, that is an error (or the environment entry wins; choose one, and test it).
+- `AgentSkillsPreload` reads the registry and the visibility predicate of the tool (`SkillsToolContext.registry`, `SkillsToolContext.visibilityPredicate`). Thus a skill that the tool hides is also not preloaded.
+- The `SkillsCatalogTool` does not show its context now (`OperationTool.context` is private). This task needs a public read of the context or of the registry and the predicate from FoundationModelsSkills. Ask for it in that package first, then use it here.
+
+## Changes here
+
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Run/AgentEnvironment.swift` (the `skills` property at line 43, the init at line 157).
+- `Run/AgentSkillsPreload.swift`: use the predicate of the tool, not `isModelVisible`.
+- `Run/AgentSessionMaker.swift:53`, `Run/AgentRunner.swift:340`.
+- `Tools/ToolCatalog.swift`, the doc example at line 11.
+- The 9 files that call `AgentEnvironment(`: Sources, Tests, Examples/agents-demo, IntegrationTests.
+- README, DocC (`RunningAnAgent.md:20-25`, `FoundationModelsAgents.md`), `docs/skills-and-agents.md`, and `ReadmeExampleSource.swift`.
+
+## Acceptance criteria
+
+- [ ] A host gives the skills tool one time, and the runs get it as `skills` and use it for the preload.
+- [ ] A skill that the visibility predicate of the tool hides is not preloaded, and gives the hidden-skill warning.
+- [ ] `SkillsPreloadTests` pass with the new init.
+- [ ] The README example and its test agree.
+- [ ] `swift build` and `swift test` pass with no warnings.
\ No newline at end of file
